hero.title2: From field sensor to command centre.
hero.subtitle: IoT & Edge Intelligence monitors and automates water and energy networks, from field sensor to command centre, with OT security alongside.

context.title: Where we play
context.body: Energy and utilities lead with IoT and OT security. IoT & Edge and Cybersecurity are primary fits; Sovereign AI, Intelligent Operations and Blockchain are relevant. The typical first engagement is an IoT pilot zone or an OT security assessment.

challenges.title: National water mandates
challenges.body: MEWA's electronic-metering mandate, the National Water Strategy 2030, the Treated Wastewater Reuse Policy and the NWC smart-meter program.

challenges.title: OT/ICS security
challenges.body: NCA OTCC applies to operators of OT/ICS environments.

challenges.title: Reporting against 2030 targets
challenges.body: Automated compliance reports, SWA · WERA reporting standards, and KPIs tracked against 2030 targets.

useCases.title: IoT pilot zone
useCases.body: A pilot zone POC on a defined set of wells, reservoirs or meters.

useCases.title: OT security assessment
useCases.body: OT asset inventory, segmentation design and OT monitoring, with secure remote access.

useCases.title: Six smart-water solutions
useCases.body: Groundwater monitoring, level and leak detection, pump automation, quality monitoring, smart metering and infrastructure asset management.

useCases.title: Beyond water
useCases.body: The same platform serves energy, solar, manufacturing, mining and critical infrastructure.

vision2030.body: Six water solutions on one platform, mapped to Saudi regulators, with KPIs tracked against 2030 targets in the command centre.

seo.title: Energy & Utilities Solutions | Smart Water IoT & OT Security
seo.description: IoT pilot zones and OT security assessments for Saudi water and energy operators: six smart-water solutions mapped to MEWA, NWC and SWA mandates.
